newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fewer visitors, less travel by NZers in June - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: Fewer visitors, less travel by NZers in June - SNZ.

text.p: New Zealand residents left for 109,700 short trips overseas in June 1997, seven percent fewer than in June 1996, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.
"This drop compares with an increase of 33 percent between the June 1995 and June 1996 months," SNZ said.
During the year to June 1997, New Zealand residents made 1.1 million short trips overseas, an increase of 10 percent on the June 1996 year.
Overseas visitor arrivals in the month of June totalled 83,390, a decrease of five percent on June 1996. This compared with a 19 percent rise between the June 1995 and 1996 months.
"After adjusting for seasonal variations, visitor arrivals between May and June 1997 increased by two percent compared with an eight percent increase between April and May 1997," SNZ said.
During the year ended June 1997, visitor arrivals totalled 1.54 million, an increase of five percent when compared with the previous June year.
SNZ said there was a net outflow of 160 permanent and long-term migrants during June 1997. This compared with a net gain of 570 in June 1996.
For the June 1997 year the net gain was 16,790, down 43 percent on the 29,510 net gain in the June 1996 year.
